mentions.name: SubjectiveZero
mentions.description: A free and open source agentic node editor for creating realtime 2D/3D visual effects, built as a coding-harness-style foundation for visual effects rather than a traditional tool. It keeps a node editor paradigm but makes nodes more malleable, with a UX flow optimized for ideation and iteration and an adjustable abstraction ladder: technical users get granular control while others can drive it with prompts. Determinism features include an agent graph to constrain agent workflows, MCP that drives UI changes as the agent makes progress, agent work verification and coordination, and basic model routing to tweak the intelligence/speed ratio.
mentions.problem: Using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Codex to make art and installations with existing 2D/3D visual effect tools (TouchDesigner, ComfyUI) involves a lot of friction and papercuts when it comes to deterministic workflows and concept iteration.
mentions.audience: Creative professionals and artists making visual effects, art, and installations; technical users wanting granular control as well as users who prefer high-level prompts and vibes.
mentions.source_excerpt: SubjectiveZero is the free and open source project that resulted from it. It’s still following the classic node editor paradigms but making the nodes absolutely more malleable while also combining a user experience flow optimized for ideation and iteration.
mentions.author: tasoeur
